name: Gnawa

definition.sound: Moroccan trance-healing music of a Sufi brotherhood of sub-Saharan origin: guembri bass lute, iron qraqeb castanets and call-and-response chant.
markers: Loud clacking iron qraqeb in a fast triplet
Repetitive call-and-response chant building to trance

note: Ritual music of Moroccans descended from West African slaves.
